scope_review: Round001 used h=0 and a density-preserving common codilation corresponding to first-order h=1 only. It did not optimize free h and did not exclude the h-family. Round002 certified only one negative quarter-tail slice interval at h=0.
input: Exact C primary lattice plus epsilon satellite orbit at a fixed new displacement z. Mass per period1+epsilon; threshold lambda=1+h*epsilon. Primary length family1..4; full actual satellite capture at limiting primary radii.
normalization: R(epsilon,z,h)=lambda*U(epsilon,z,h)/(1+epsilon); derivative D=B(z,h)+kappa(z)+(h-1)*C; common radius derivative r*(n_sat/N-h)/5. Equivalent common lattice dilation rate k=h/5 to first order.
new_cell_selection: Use the exact primary endpoint arrangement in the reflected halfcell. Enumerate nondecreasing tail interval-index multisets, prefer the fewest distinct tail intervals, then lexicographic indices including first coordinate. Select the first uncovered open cell by exact mask intersection. Refine each coordinate to the full satellite-count event interval containing its midpoint, selecting an interior point if that midpoint is itself an event. Fix exactly this one open displacement cell and its centre. No displacement objective grid.
structural_audit: Check all feasible primary raw boxes for zero widths and all same-orientation facet coincidences for unequal limiting radii. If none occur, derive a concave piecewise-affine free-threshold response consisting of the exposed-boundary affine term minus contact-opening hinge losses. If the audit fails, stop this shortcut rather than silently assume concavity.
h_candidates: After exact contact-volume and satellite-count integration, select at most3 h-events: the global weighted-slope crossing event and its immediate neighbors, or plateau endpoints. Event locations are exact ratios of Q(u,v) elements. No fixed h grid and no small-epsilon derivative fitting.
limits: 120 seconds and200000 recursive nodes per geometric or reflected-halfcell integration; at most32 symmetry-reduced reflection evaluations for this one displacement. Save a compute-limit receipt if exceeded.
acceptance: Any certified positive D must be locked for parent review, then finite-epsilon reconstruction at exact lambda and mass normalization. Otherwise certify only the selected displacement's finite-family free-h obstruction, not all displacements, the full periodic maximal function or C5.
transfer: Any finite positive-epsilon candidate must retain distinct atom counts, common radii, exact threshold lambda>0, receiver union and period mass1+epsilon, followed by finite collar and smooth L1 transfer. No MATLAB and no commits.
